# Purpose

This short notebook **only replaces the previously updated versions of Figures 1.2, 2, 3, and 6**.

It does **not** recreate or overwrite Figures 1, 1.2, 4, or 5.

The replacements address:

- **Figure 1.2:** more cautious title/subtitle so the plot shows persistence without implying a significant interaction for every trait.
- **Figure 2:** shorter subtitle so the FDR statement is not clipped.
- **Figure 3:** more cautious title that does not imply a formally significant
  background/pair interaction.
- **Figure 6:** more neutral interpretation note for traits where lower values
  are generally favorable.

The updated PNG/PDF files are overwritten in:

`05_results/advisor_meeting_2026-09-21/figures`


# 1. Output folder and helper

```{r folders-helper}
meeting_root <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "05_results",
  "advisor_meeting_2026-09-21"
)

meeting_figure_dir <- file.path(
  meeting_root,
  "figures"
)

dir.create(
  meeting_figure_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

save_replacement <- function(
  plot_object,
  file_stub,
  width,
  height
) {

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      meeting_figure_dir,
      paste0(
        file_stub,
        ".png"
      )
    ),
    plot = plot_object,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 400,
    bg = "white"
  )

  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(
      meeting_figure_dir,
      paste0(
        file_stub,
        ".pdf"
      )
    ),
    plot = plot_object,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    device = grDevices::cairo_pdf
  )

  message(
    "Replaced: ",
    file_stub,
    ".png / .pdf"
  )
}
```

# 2. Import formal yarn data

```{r import-yarn}
yarn_file <- file.path(
  paths$data_processed,
  "yarn_2022_sample_level_clean.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(yarn_file)) {
  stop(
    "Missing cleaned yarn file:\n",
    yarn_file
  )
}

yarn <- readr::read_csv(
  yarn_file,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    background = factor(
      background,
      levels = c(
        "Acala",
        "Deltapine",
        "Georgia",
        "Paymaster"
      )
    ),
    qtl_status = factor(
      qtl_status,
      levels = c(
        "Negative",
        "Positive",
        "Parent_Check"
      )
    ),
    field_rep = factor(
      field_rep_inferred
    ),
    pair_id = interaction(
      background,
      nil_set,
      drop = TRUE
    )
  )

formal_yarn <- yarn |>
  dplyr::filter(
    material_type == "NIIL",
    qtl_status %in% c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    )
  ) |>
  droplevels()

if (nrow(formal_yarn) != 64) {
  stop(
    "Expected 64 formal NIIL observations; found ",
    nrow(formal_yarn),
    "."
  )
}
```

# 3. Replace Figure 1.2

This replacement changes only the wording of Figure 1.2. The underlying data and
plot structure remain unchanged.

```{r figure-1-2}
afis_candidates <- list.files(
  paths$data_processed,
  pattern = "afis.*2022.*\\.csv$|2022.*afis.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

required_stage_patterns <- c(
  "Bale",
  "Opened",
  "Carded",
  "Sliver"
)

stage_data <- NULL

for (candidate in afis_candidates) {

  candidate_data <- tryCatch(
    readr::read_csv(
      candidate,
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(candidate_data)) {
    next
  }

  candidate_names <- names(
    candidate_data
  )

  has_all_stages <- all(
    vapply(
      required_stage_patterns,
      function(stage_name) {
        any(
          stringr::str_detect(
            candidate_names,
            stringr::regex(
              stage_name,
              ignore_case = TRUE
            )
          )
        )
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  )

  if (has_all_stages) {
    stage_data <- candidate_data
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(stage_data)) {
  stop(
    "No processed 2022 AFIS wide file with Bale, Opened, Carded, and Sliver columns was found."
  )
}

sample_key_file <- file.path(
  paths$data_processed,
  "sample_key_2022.csv"
)

if (
  !("qtl_status" %in% names(stage_data)) &&
  file.exists(sample_key_file)
) {

  sample_key <- readr::read_csv(
    sample_key_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  clean_identifier <- function(x) {
    x |>
      as.character() |>
      stringr::str_trim() |>
      stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "") |>
      dplyr::na_if("")
  }

  find_matching_column <- function(
    data_names,
    patterns
  ) {

    hits <- unique(
      unlist(
        purrr::map(
          patterns,
          ~ data_names[
            stringr::str_detect(
              data_names,
              stringr::regex(
                .x,
                ignore_case = TRUE
              )
            )
          ]
        )
      )
    )

    if (length(hits) == 0) {
      return(
        NA_character_
      )
    }

    hits[[1]]
  }

  stage_id_col <- find_matching_column(
    names(stage_data),
    c(
      "^field_sample_id$",
      "field.*sample.*id",
      "^sample_id$"
    )
  )

  key_id_col <- find_matching_column(
    names(sample_key),
    c(
      "^field_sample_id$",
      "field.*sample.*id",
      "^sample_id$"
    )
  )

  if (
    !is.na(stage_id_col) &&
    !is.na(key_id_col)
  ) {

    stage_data <- stage_data |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        .join_id = clean_identifier(
          .data[[stage_id_col]]
        )
      ) |>
      dplyr::left_join(
        sample_key |>
          dplyr::mutate(
            .join_id = clean_identifier(
              .data[[key_id_col]]
            )
          ) |>
          dplyr::select(
            .join_id,
            dplyr::any_of(
              c(
                "qtl_status",
                "material_type"
              )
            )
          ),
        by = ".join_id"
      )
  }
}

if (!("qtl_status" %in% names(stage_data))) {
  stop(
    "qtl_status could not be resolved in the stage-wide AFIS dataset."
  )
}

find_stage_column <- function(
  data_names,
  stage_regex,
  trait_regex
) {

  hits <- data_names[
    stringr::str_detect(
      data_names,
      stringr::regex(
        stage_regex,
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    ) &
    stringr::str_detect(
      data_names,
      stringr::regex(
        trait_regex,
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  ]

  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    return(
      NA_character_
    )
  }

  hits[[1]]
}

trait_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~trait_label, ~trait_regex,
  "UQL(w)", "UQL.?w|UQL_w",
  "L5", "L5",
  "SFC(n)", "SFC.?n|SFC_n",
  "Nep count", "Nep.*count|Neps"
)

stage_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~processing_stage, ~stage_regex,
  "Bale", "^Bale|Bale",
  "Opened", "Opened|Open",
  "Carded", "Carded|Card",
  "Sliver", "Sliver"
)

plot_specs <- tidyr::crossing(
  trait_map,
  stage_map
) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    column_name = find_stage_column(
      data_names = names(stage_data),
      stage_regex = stage_regex,
      trait_regex = trait_regex
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      column_name
    )
  )

stage_qtl_data <- stage_data

if ("material_type" %in% names(stage_qtl_data)) {
  stage_qtl_data <- stage_qtl_data |>
    dplyr::filter(
      material_type == "NIIL"
    )
}

stage_qtl_data <- stage_qtl_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    qtl_status %in% c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    qtl_status = factor(
      qtl_status,
      levels = c(
        "Negative",
        "Positive"
      )
    )
  )

stage_qtl_long <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  plot_specs,
  function(
    trait_label,
    trait_regex,
    processing_stage,
    stage_regex,
    column_name
  ) {

    tibble::tibble(
      qtl_status = stage_qtl_data$qtl_status,
      trait = trait_label,
      processing_stage = processing_stage,
      value = as.numeric(
        stage_qtl_data[[column_name]]
      )
    )
  }
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    processing_stage = factor(
      processing_stage,
      levels = c(
        "Bale",
        "Opened",
        "Carded",
        "Sliver"
      )
    )
  )

stage_qtl_summary <- stage_qtl_long |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    trait,
    processing_stage,
    qtl_status
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(
      !is.na(value)
    ),
    mean = mean(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    se = stats::sd(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) /
      sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

figure_1_2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  stage_qtl_summary,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = processing_stage,
    y = mean,
    group = qtl_status,
    shape = qtl_status,
    linetype = qtl_status
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = mean - se,
      ymax = mean + se
    ),
    width = 0.10
  ) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(
    ~ trait,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Figure 1.2. qFL-Chr.25 fiber phenotypes remain evident across processing stages",
    subtitle = "2022 NIIL AFIS samples; QTL-positive and QTL-negative means ± SE",
    x = "Processing stage",
    y = "AFIS trait value",
    shape = "qFL-Chr.25",
    linetype = "qFL-Chr.25"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor =
      ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

figure_1_2

save_replacement(
  figure_1_2,
  "Figure_1_2_AFIS_processing_stage_QTL_persistence",
  width = 10,
  height = 7.5
)
```

# 4. Replace Figure 2

```{r figure-2}
primary_yarn_traits <- c(
  "skein_mn_tex",
  "yarn_tenacity_cn_tex",
  "yarn_elongation_pct",
  "yarn_evenness_cv_pct",
  "yarn_thin_50",
  "yarn_thick_50",
  "yarn_neps_200",
  "yarn_hairiness"
)

trait_labels <- c(
  skein_mn_tex = "Skein strength",
  yarn_tenacity_cn_tex = "Single-end tenacity",
  yarn_elongation_pct = "Yarn elongation",
  yarn_evenness_cv_pct = "Evenness CV",
  yarn_thin_50 = "Thin places",
  yarn_thick_50 = "Thick places",
  yarn_neps_200 = "Neps +200%",
  yarn_hairiness = "Hairiness"
)

fit_qtl_contrast <- function(trait_name) {

  model_formula <- stats::as.formula(
    paste0(
      trait_name,
      " ~ background * qtl_status + ",
      "field_rep + (1 | pair_id)"
    )
  )

  fit <- lmerTest::lmer(
    model_formula,
    data = formal_yarn,
    REML = TRUE,
    control = lme4::lmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(
        maxfun = 100000
      )
    )
  )

  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
    fit,
    ~ qtl_status
  )

  result <- as.data.frame(
    emmeans::contrast(
      emm,
      method = list(
        "Positive - Negative" = c(-1, 1)
      )
    )
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    trait = trait_name,
    estimate = result$estimate,
    se = result$SE,
    p_value = result$p.value,
    lower = result$estimate - 1.96 * result$SE,
    upper = result$estimate + 1.96 * result$SE
  )
}

overall_qtl_effects <- purrr::map_dfr(
  primary_yarn_traits,
  fit_qtl_contrast
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fdr_p = stats::p.adjust(
      p_value,
      method = "BH"
    ),
    trait_label = unname(
      trait_labels[
        trait
      ]
    )
  )

trait_sd <- formal_yarn |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(
        primary_yarn_traits
      ),
      ~ stats::sd(
        .x,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "trait_sd"
  )

figure_2_data <- overall_qtl_effects |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    trait_sd,
    by = "trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    standardized_effect =
      estimate /
      trait_sd,
    standardized_lower =
      lower /
      trait_sd,
    standardized_upper =
      upper /
      trait_sd,
    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = rev(
        unname(
          trait_labels
        )
      )
    )
  )

figure_2 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  figure_2_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = standardized_effect,
    y = trait_label
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbarh(
    ggplot2::aes(
      xmin = standardized_lower,
      xmax = standardized_upper
    ),
    height = 0.16
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Figure 2. Overall qFL-Chr.25 effects on primary yarn traits",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "QTL-positive minus QTL-negative; standardized effects ± approximate 95% CI.\n",
      "No trait remained significant after FDR correction."
    ),
    x = "Standardized QTL effect (SD units)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor =
      ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

figure_2

save_replacement(
  figure_2,
  "Figure_2_overall_yarn_QTL_effects_updated",
  width = 10,
  height = 6.5
)
```

# 6. Import matched fiber data for Figure 6

```{r import-fiber}
raw_matches <- list.files(
  paths$data_raw,
  pattern = "^2022 UGA Mini-Spin Raw Data.*\\.xlsx$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(raw_matches) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Expected exactly one 2022 UGA Mini-Spin Raw Data workbook in 02_data_raw."
  )
}

raw_file <- raw_matches[[1]]

raw_sheets <- readxl::excel_sheets(
  raw_file
)

sheet_dimensions <- purrr::map_dfr(
  raw_sheets,
  function(sheet_name) {

    temp <- tryCatch(
      readxl::read_excel(
        raw_file,
        sheet = sheet_name,
        n_max = 100,
        .name_repair = "unique_quiet"
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (is.null(temp)) {
      return(
        tibble::tibble(
          sheet = sheet_name,
          rows_read = NA_integer_,
          columns = NA_integer_
        )
      )
    }

    tibble::tibble(
      sheet = sheet_name,
      rows_read = nrow(temp),
      columns = ncol(temp)
    )
  }
)

analysis_sheet <- sheet_dimensions |>
  dplyr::filter(
    rows_read >= 90,
    columns >= 114
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(
    sheet
  )

if (length(analysis_sheet) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Could not uniquely identify the 2022 114-column analysis sheet."
  )
}

raw_unfiltered <- readxl::read_excel(
  raw_file,
  sheet = analysis_sheet[[1]],
  .name_repair = "unique_quiet"
)

genotype_check <- stringr::str_trim(
  as.character(
    raw_unfiltered[[1]]
  )
)

rep_check <- suppressWarnings(
  as.integer(
    raw_unfiltered[[2]]
  )
)

keep_row <- (
  !is.na(genotype_check) &
  genotype_check != "" &
  !is.na(rep_check)
)

raw_2022 <- raw_unfiltered[
  keep_row,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

standardize_raw_genotype <- function(x) {

  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_replace(
    x,
    "_01$",
    ""
  )
  x <- stringr::str_replace_all(
    x,
    "[^A-Za-z0-9]",
    ""
  )

  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "GA2018001" ~ "GA201800",
    x == "GA2018081" ~ "GA201808",
    TRUE ~ x
  )
}

fiber <- tibble::tibble(
  genotype =
    standardize_raw_genotype(
      raw_2022[[1]]
    ),
  field_rep_inferred =
    suppressWarnings(
      as.integer(
        raw_2022[[2]]
      )
    ),
  hvi_microgin_UHML =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[38]]
    ),
  afis_microgin_Lw =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[45]]
    ),
  afis_microgin_UQLw =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[47]]
    ),
  afis_microgin_Ln =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[49]]
    ),
  afis_microgin_SFCn =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[51]]
    ),
  afis_microgin_L5 =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[52]]
    ),
  fibrogram_microgin_UHMLf =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[64]]
    ),
  fibrogram_microgin_UQLf =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[66]]
    ),
  fibrogram_microgin_SFCf =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[69]]
    ),
  hvi_classing_UHML =
    as.numeric(
      raw_2022[[72]]
    )
)

formal_fiber_yarn <- yarn |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    fiber,
    by = c(
      "genotype",
      "field_rep_inferred"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    material_type == "NIIL",
    qtl_status %in% c(
      "Negative",
      "Positive"
    )
  ) |>
  droplevels()
```

# 7. Replace Figure 6

```{r figure-6}
core_fiber_traits <- c(
  "hvi_microgin_UHML",
  "afis_microgin_UQLw",
  "afis_microgin_L5",
  "fibrogram_microgin_UHMLf",
  "fibrogram_microgin_UQLf",
  "hvi_classing_UHML",
  "afis_microgin_Lw",
  "afis_microgin_Ln",
  "afis_microgin_SFCn",
  "fibrogram_microgin_SFCf"
)

core_fiber_labels <- c(
  hvi_microgin_UHML = "Microgin HVI UHML",
  afis_microgin_UQLw = "Microgin AFIS UQL(w)",
  afis_microgin_L5 = "Microgin AFIS L5",
  fibrogram_microgin_UHMLf = "Microgin fibrogram UHML",
  fibrogram_microgin_UQLf = "Microgin fibrogram UQL",
  hvi_classing_UHML = "Classing HVI UHML",
  afis_microgin_Lw = "Microgin AFIS L(w)",
  afis_microgin_Ln = "Microgin AFIS L(n)",
  afis_microgin_SFCn = "Microgin AFIS SFC(n)",
  fibrogram_microgin_SFCf = "Microgin fibrogram SFC"
)

dp213_traits <- c(
  core_fiber_traits,
  "yarn_tenacity_cn_tex",
  "skein_mn_tex",
  "yarn_elongation_pct",
  "yarn_evenness_cv_pct",
  "yarn_thin_50",
  "yarn_neps_200",
  "yarn_hairiness"
)

dp213_labels <- c(
  core_fiber_labels,
  yarn_tenacity_cn_tex = "Yarn tenacity",
  skein_mn_tex = "Skein strength",
  yarn_elongation_pct = "Yarn elongation",
  yarn_evenness_cv_pct = "Evenness CV",
  yarn_thin_50 = "Thin places",
  yarn_neps_200 = "Yarn neps",
  yarn_hairiness = "Hairiness"
)

dp213_means <- formal_fiber_yarn |>
  dplyr::filter(
    nil_set == "DP213"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    qtl_status,
    dplyr::all_of(
      dp213_traits
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(
      dp213_traits
    ),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    trait,
    qtl_status
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_value = mean(
      value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = qtl_status,
    values_from = mean_value
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    raw_difference = Positive - Negative
  )

formal_trait_sd <- formal_fiber_yarn |>
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::all_of(
      dp213_traits
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::everything(),
      ~ stats::sd(
        .x,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    dplyr::everything(),
    names_to = "trait",
    values_to = "formal_sd"
  )

dp213_effect_profile <- dp213_means |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    formal_trait_sd,
    by = "trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    standardized_difference =
      raw_difference /
      formal_sd,
    trait_label = unname(
      dp213_labels[
        trait
      ]
    ),
    domain = dplyr::if_else(
      trait %in% core_fiber_traits,
      "Fiber",
      "Yarn"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      standardized_difference
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trait_label = factor(
      trait_label,
      levels = trait_label
    )
  )

figure_6 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  dp213_effect_profile,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = standardized_difference,
    y = trait_label,
    shape = domain
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = 0,
      xend = standardized_difference,
      yend = trait_label
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 3.2
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Figure 6. DP213 shows a coordinated response across the core fiber panel and yarn traits",
    subtitle = "QTL-positive minus QTL-negative differences standardized by the 64-NIIL trait SD.",
    caption = paste0(
      "For SFC, evenness CV, thin places, neps, and hairiness, ",
      "lower values are generally favorable."
    ),
    x = "DP213 QTL effect (SD units)",
    y = NULL,
    shape = "Trait domain"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    panel.grid.minor =
      ggplot2::element_blank()
  )

figure_6

save_replacement(
  figure_6,
  "Figure_6_DP213_fiber_to_yarn_effect_profile_updated",
  width = 10,
  height = 8.4
)
```
